title: Case manifest
description: Catalog row case-manifest 2.0.0: one case (data/derived/manifests/<case>.json): its question, sources, artifacts, the contract-1 reports and what the case reads of other cases (depends_on).

source_details.description: What the Context view shows of each source, from the source registry.

contract.description: The contract-1 report of each source the case read, keyed by source id.

expect.description: The checked expectation of the case: [low, high] per named result.

depends_on.description: What the producer reads of other cases, stated by the producer from the paths it opens and the modules it imports (never by hand), sorted by kind then ref; empty when the case reads nothing of another case. The engine is never listed: every case depends on it.

kind.description: document: a committed document of another case the producer reads; code: a product module of another case it imports.

ref.description: <case>/<file>.json or manifests/<case>.json for a document; pipeline.cases.<module> for code.
